premises.text: Computing devices will continuously pay attention and understand conversations to anticipate information needs.
premises.evidence_span: we're going to live in a world where the computing devices all around us will pay attention continuously. They will understand what we say in our conversations, and they'll use that information to better anticipate the information that we might need.

premises.text: MindMeld is the first voice and video calling app that understands spoken information to provide relevant data.
premises.evidence_span: it's the first voice and video calling app that actually understands what you say in order to put relevant information right at your fingertips.

premises.text: The core team has significant expertise in extracting meaning from audio and video information.
premises.evidence_span: our core team built one of the largest infrastructures ever constructed to extract meaning from streams of audio and video information.

premises.text: The technology has the potential to fundamentally improve conversations.
premises.evidence_span: this technology had the potential to fundamentally improve how we have conversations.

premises.text: MindMeld can provide real-time information during conversations.
premises.evidence_span: Mindmeld understood what he said and automatically pulled in related information.

premises.text: The anticipatory computing engine analyzes conversations to predict future information needs.
premises.evidence_span: it analyzes the last 10 minutes of your conversation to anticipate what you might need in the next 10 seconds.

premises.text: The platform is opening up for third-party developers to create new applications.
premises.evidence_span: we're opening up our developer platform early next year so that developers and third parties can build new applications.
